pages.text: The spawn village has a $(l)market$(): one stall for each job, selling supplies and rare goods for $(item)Gold Coins$(). The stock never runs out.$(br2)A stall gives $(l)25% off$() to members of its own job, so a friend with the right job can buy for you.

$(l)Player shops$(): craft a $(item)Vending Machine$() or another shop block, fill it and set your prices in coins. Friends buy even while you are away, and the coins wait inside until you collect them.$(br2)Put coins in the slots on the shop screen to pay; change comes back there.
